description: A young man with dark hair in a waistcoat and work trousers sits slumped on a rocky ledge, one hand pressed to his chest, with a long pointed iron bar lying across the rocks beside him. Behind him, several men in flat caps and waistcoats stand among shovels and tools in a rocky cutting, with smoke drifting in the background. A wooden barrel sits at the right edge. The style is a painted, realistic 19th-century scene with no visible text.
